cohort: The participants were fetal rodents with retinoic acid-induced myelomeningocele defects.
finding: Surgical repair of myelomeningocele with a PMSC-seeded ECM patch in fetal rodents was feasible, resulting in significantly less cord compression and decreased apoptotic cell density compared to ECM-only controls or unrepaired pups.
mod_finding: All pups were collected via caesarean section.
gest_age: Embryonic age (EA) 19 (for repair) to EA 21 (for collection)
